rows.TEXT: In her youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. She then became sovereign of her realm.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Known in her times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended her reign of terror. She is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to her will.

Loremaster Fogfell 
"Alas, he has not consented to speak with our Loremasters since the first great wars. He left the order in protest."

Loremaster Flinthide 
"Surely he will consent to help us...after all, much time has passed. And much has changed. Who can ignore the call of Wotan?"

Druidess 
"I was Greenflint's pupil until he chose to leave the Order. He lives north of this city.  Please, let me go to him. He distrusts the High Council, yet he will listen to me."

Greenflint 
"My dear girl! You warm the frozen heart of an old man!  How long it has been since I have seen you?"

Druidess 
"Many years...sadly, many circumstances have intervened in my attempts to visit you. I come to you now on behalf of Wotan, We've a dilemma which requires your great knowledge."

Greenflint 
"Why would your great Loremasters have need of my wisdom; the wisdom which they once scorned?"

Druidess 
"Oh, master...where to begin? There have been a great many tragedies. You have missed so much. Please, we will share stories on the way."

Greenflint 
"I will follow to sate my curiosity, but don't think this means I agree to help!"

Greenflint 
"Home? True, it is  nice to see the white hillsides of the Dwarven realm again, but I do not consider this city my home."

Loremaster 
"Yes... We have a matter that we must discuss with you; we have nobody else to turn to!"

Greenflint 
"So I've heard. We can discuss it while you feed me."

Greenflint 
"I must study this text further... You say that the wolves claimed to be agents of Wotan? Most interesting!"

Hermit Greenflint 
"Yes, we will need two more Loremasters in order to conduct this ceremony. I am saddened by the deaths of my old friends, Darkstone, Thunderhammer and Ironhill. Many arcane secrets must have died with them."

Greenflint 
"I will require two of my brethren to fulfill this mission. Search out the Hermit Hillrust south of here. Hermit Grimpeak is harder to find, and far less hospitable! Last that I heard, Grimpeak was studying the southern ice fields."

"So! Greenflint requests me? Why would he send you as his messengers? Strange... I thought he bore a grudge against your Order. I've never been one to ignore that Dwarf's wisdom. I will get my pack prepared."

Hermit Grimpeak 
"Greenflint! Yes, he has my deepest respect. He taught me everything that I know about this world...and the next. I will return to the Capital, for Greenflint."

Hermit Hillrust 
"Greetings, Clansfolk! Hermit Greenflint? Well... I hear that he has not strayed too far from home, as he is accustomed to the northern climate!"

Hermit Grimspeak 
"Hermit Greenflint? I have not heard that name spoken in quite a while. I haven't heard anything spoken in quite a while, all things considering. These ice formations have been my sole occupation..."

"Can you help us find him? We need the skill of an experienced Loremaster for a great ceremony. Mighty Wotan has requested an audience with the Loremasters, we must hurry to enact his will!"

Greenflint 
"Today we gather to commune with Wotan. We have overcome both the novelty of our task and the loss of our Loremasters. Let us congratulate ourselves on this day of miracles!"

Dark Lachla'an 
"Move aside, Dwarves! Your work is done!"

Grimpeak 
"Flee! Take the runes to safety!"

Dark Elf  Lachla'an 
"Gallean! Come! Your child awaits your approval!"

Greenflint 
"It is too late! The sacred circle has been cast...we have no control over its use!"

Dark Elf Lachla'an 
"See now! Your perfect creation, father! Mother has given me new life! Together we will teach the Elves our ways! Isn't it a beautiful thing?"

Venerable Warrior 
"Gallean? We've been deceived! The message was never from Wotan! Dwarves! Defend yourselves!"

Dwarf 
"That creature! It looked like an Elf, yet had the stench of something long dead! How could this be any child of the Elven god?"

Loremaster 
"The Undead somehow knew the nature of our ceremony, they knew that we were calling upon the gods...they have used our sacred circle to profane Gallean with their cruelty to his son!"

Dwarf 
"What good would come from angering Gallean?"

Loremaster 
"I wouldn't want to try to comprehend the will of that twisted Goddess. I saw...something...just after that creature addressed Gallean. It was enormous and it headed towards the forest. Whatever it is, the Elves will certainly see it coming!"

Loremaster Hillrust 
"Ah! I have heard of your legendary rule, my Queen."

Hermit Hillrust 
"You are certainly more pleasant to gaze upon than old Cloudkeeper - may his soul find glory. This disposes me well towards helping Greenflint in the rite for Wotan."

Loremaster Grimpeak 
"The Dwarves have dragged me far away from my work..."

Queen Yataa'Halli 
"Yes, Wotan has given our people a holy task! Loremaster Greenflint swears by your abilities, and you honor us with your presence."

Loremaster Grimpeak 
"I will be at the ceremony. But I serve Wotan, not the crown. Do not expect me to rejoin the Order."

Alchemist 
"It cannot be true...Gallean has returned?"

Alchemist 
"He was slain by Wotan many  years ago. I have been told that Gods cannot die, but certainly he was decimated by fire!"

Novice 
"I remember Loremaster Greenflint. A stubborn fellow he was!"

Novice 
"He disagreed with Loremasters on all points. I wonder how they will fare together now?"

Druidess 
"I cannot wait to see Master Greenflint! He has always had a fervent love for serving Wotan...it's just a shame he could never see eye to eye with the Order."

Tenderfoot 
"I wonder... Why did Wotan and Gallean quarrel?"

Archdruidess 
"Wotan did not accept Gallean's demand for land, yet Gallean kept insisting. His Elves were greedy and were not content in their forest homes. They would certainly have invaded our lands. Wotan was simply protecting his children."

Peasant 
"You intend to rule us, half-men? The Count of Crowley governed us unjustly. Most of our people have left, but some will choose to remain with their homes. We pray you are kinder lords."

King's Guard 
"That, Human, is an issue for the Queen. This Crowley you mention, we've heard nothing but ill will towards his exploits! Perhaps we shall challenge this man in battle yet!"

Veteran 
"I wonder...why would the Barbarians keep this lovely library intact? What respect have they for knowledge?"

Alchemist 
"Perhaps we underestimate them, they seem to understand the power contained in words. See here, this tome contains the secret of controlling the elements! A rare find! We will search the entire library for more treasure."

Flame Caster 
"Count Crowley's standard flies here! It is a shame that we did not meet him in our conquest of this city. He has much to answer for."

Dwarf 
"I hear those who do not support his Inquisition are branded heretics and punished by his army!"

Venerable Warrior 
"Ah! Though I find humans dishonorable, it pains me to see them like this. Crowley has claimed these defenseless peasants as his serfs! We have done them a good turn indeed by destroying his armies."

Archdruidess 
"It is tarnished, but its power cannot be diminished! This talisman will allow us to smite our enemies!"

Hermit Greenflint 
"I never believed I would return... and now I've agreed help with the very ritual which caused my departure! Perhaps my mind has grown addled with my age."

Druidess 
"Master, please! Forget the past. The Dwarven folk have learned from their mistakes. Perhaps they would have learned sooner with your aid. If only you hadn't left us..."

Runemaster 
"This temple was once dedicated to Gallean and Salonielle! One fateful day, Wotan tore Gallean's heart from his chest and hurled it into the sun. Salonielle vanished but returned as the godess Mortis with an army of walking corpses!"

Runemaster 
"The Elves were forsaken with the death of Gallean... Salonielle no longer had the will to rule them, she only cared about regaining her lost lover."

Runemaster 
"And so, the Elves have been without the spiritual help of a God for the past century. Their race is scattered and weak."

Druidess 
"An excellent account. Perhaps you should have been a Loremaster!"
